title: Memory Boundary
description: An access boundary for a knowledge source.

source.description: Name of the knowledge source this boundary applies to.

agent_read.description: Whether agents may read this source.

agent_read_scope.description: If agent_read is scoped, what the agent may read: specific folders, fields, or tags.

agent_write.description: Whether agents may write to this source.

requires_review.description: Whether agent writes require human review before taking effect.

restricted.description: Whether this source contains data agents must never access.

enforced_by.description: How this boundary is enforced: file permissions, API scope, manual review, other.
